implementation.identity: Reuses existing rooted per-application canonical PackageService application and bootstrap loader objects. Nullable loader values resolve to bootstrap provenance. Unknown ClassLoader/subclass objects fail API_UNAVAILABLE, wrong object types throw ClassCastException; no loader argument is silently ignored.
implementation.thread_context: Bound managed application main Thread begins with its exact defining application loader. JNI-adopted native peers begin with null/bootstrap context, as specified by JNI and consistent with the API26 native-peer constructor. Ordinary Thread constructors and DefaultThreadFactory copy the actual parent virtual getContextClassLoader result; validation and callbacks occur without retaining RefCell borrows.
implementation.mutation_and_lifetime: get/setContextClassLoader use real Java Thread records. Set validates before mutation; explicit null is preserved. A Thread traces its context as a Java reference. A retained detached Thread keeps its context/name/id with isAlive false; a fresh peer for a reused owner gets new bootstrap context. Real original-main detach consumes only the managed-main initialization marker, so explicit reattach honors its name and bootstrap context instead of being relabeled main.
implementation.catalog: Registers only the implemented exact Thread context getter/setter and existing Context/Class.getClassLoader plus ClassLoader.loadClass methods. Shared static metadata also includes the separately implemented/tested Class.forName overloads. Real DEX declarations/owners/static-kind rules continue to take precedence.
implementation.loading: ClassLoader.loadClass shares the Class.forName module bounded linking helper with explicit canonical loader scope; bootstrap cannot resolve application DEX and app classes require real declarations/hierarchy. loadClass still does not initialize the class.
implementation.scope_removed: Only newly proposed optional getParent/getSystemClassLoader handlers/catalog were removed before freeze; neither existed in this portable PackageService. A distinct Android system-loader contract is not implemented or advertised. No test assumes JVM application loader equals Android system loader.
